oracle: CASA and its casacore table reader

selection.scope: Task and attached MS tool selection, preview, original flag versions, and selected row persistence across ordinary and partitioned MeasurementSets.
selection.result: CASA and native task and tool use matched row sets and read back the same columns and original flag backups.

bins.scope: Elapsed duration and timestamp counts, block tails and sliding edge windows, independent channel bins and fit selections, scalar and spectral outputs, and absent or partially defined spectra.
bins.result: Paired summaries and persisted columns meet a 2e-7 relative tolerance. The selected-spectrum creation case follows the recorded decision.

estimators.scope: Classical, Chauvenet, hinges and fences, and fit to half moments with exposure weighting, rejected samples, raw and corrected inputs, and scratch or virtual models.
estimators.result: Matched robust and classical estimates, including non-finite output for otherwise eligible zero-exposure samples.

downstream.scope: Weighted gain solutions and application with scalar or spectral initialization and either calwt value. Casacore readback also covers a 122,880-row spectral write.
downstream.result: All four weighted solve and apply chains passed. CPARAM normalized RMS was below 4e-7, corrected visibilities below 5e-7, and weighted application below 8e-7. The 122,880-row spectral write agreed across the native batch boundary.
